triples.evidence_text: The noise measurements have been carried out with the original motor and shroud, approximately at the Best Efficiency Point (BEP) with water at ambient temperature and at 50Hz.

triples.head_surface: noise level generated by the flow through the process system
triples.tail_surface: flow through the process system (eg. valves, pipes, tanks etc.)
triples.evidence_text: Often the noise level generated by the flow through the process system (eg. valves, pipes, tanks etc.) is much higher than that generated by the pump itself.

triples.head_surface: noise level from the whole system
triples.tail_surface: take the necessary precautions with regard to personal safety
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 采取必要的人身安全防护措施
triples.evidence_text: Therefore it is important to consider the noise level from the whole system and take the necessary precautions with regard to personal safety, if required.
